comment: Pinned third-party revisions (azazel6 pattern). Every entry must carry a tree digest (sha256 over sorted relative paths + file bytes, see tools/deps.py), a license_file, and a docs/PROVENANCE.md row. Verified by tools/deps.py verify (TC-2.1) and tools/package_notices.py (TC-2.2, TC-2.3).

dependencies.name: yakumo-framework-subset
dependencies.note: ELF32/PRX loader, ISO9660 reader, PARAM.SFO, guest memory, framework core, CLI tooling; kernel/HLE adapted outside the digest tree (see provenance)

dependencies.name: pspsdk-nids
dependencies.note: NID-name facts for configs/nids.csv (generated; see provenance)

dependencies.name: atrac3p-ffmpeg-n44
dependencies.note: standalone FFmpeg n4.4 ATRAC3/ATRAC3+ decoder subset (LGPL-2.1-or-later) plus authored API; FFmpeg tag/blob pins and local deltas in provenance

dependencies.name: sdl3
dependencies.note: fetch-only SDL3 source for the Android shell, materialised by cmake/Deps.cmake into build/android-deps; never vendored or bundled

dependencies.name: libadrenotools
dependencies.note: fetch-only custom Vulkan ICD loader; arm64, API 28+; submodule liblinkernsbypass pinned separately; never vendored or bundled

dependencies.name: liblinkernsbypass
dependencies.note: fetch-only transitive dependency of libadrenotools (git submodule at lib/linkernsbypass); never vendored or bundled
